en.headline: Wildlife Photographer of the Year closes today at Science Museum
en.dek: The Hong Kong Science Museum’s special exhibition of winning images from the London Natural History Museum contest ends on Wednesday, a free-admission day.
body: The Hong Kong Science Museum said its Wildlife Photographer of the Year exhibition runs until Wednesday 2 September in the Special Exhibition Hall on the ground floor at 2 Science Museum Road, Tsim Sha Tsui East.

The display presents winning photographs from the 61st Wildlife Photographer of the Year competition organised by the Natural History Museum in London. The museum said the images were selected from more than 60,000 entries from 113 countries and territories. Admission is included in the ticket for the permanent exhibition halls, with no extra charge.
Wednesday is a free-admission day for the permanent halls. The museum’s published hours for Mondays to Wednesdays and Fridays are 10am to 7pm. It is closed on Thursdays except public holidays.
The exhibition opened on 17 April as part of the museum’s 35th-anniversary programme. Visitors reaching Tsim Sha Tsui East Station on the Tuen Ma Line can walk to the venue in about 10 minutes.

zh.headline: 科學館野外生態攝影年展今日結束 周三常設展免費入場
zh.dek: 香港科學館展出倫敦自然歷史博物館第61屆野外生態攝影大賽得獎作品，展期至9月2日，入場已包括在常設展覽票價內。
body: 香港科學館表示，「野外生態攝影年展」於尖沙咀東科學館道2號地下特備展覽廳舉行，展期至周三（9月2日）。
展覽展出由倫敦自然歷史博物館舉辦的第61屆野外生態攝影大賽得獎作品。館方指作品由113個國家及地區逾6萬幅參賽作品中選出。入場已包括在常設展覽廳票價內，不另收費。
逢星期三常設展覽廳免費入場。科學館公布的開放時間為星期一至三及五上午10時至晚上7時，星期四（公眾假期除外）休館。
展覽由4月17日起舉行，屬科學館35周年節目之一。市民可乘屯馬紦至尖東站，步行約10分鐘到達。
